title: The Great Brink's Robbery (1950)
hook: Who vanished with $2.7 million from Boston's vault?
headline: Boston's bold vault heist

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On January 17, 1950, 11 thieves stole $2.775 million on the night of January 17, 1950.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Investigators found a broken lock and a muddy boot print inside the vault's chamber.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: One robber, later identified as Joseph 'Jolly' McGinn, fled to Canada after an escape.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Police discovered the loot hidden inside a Boston-Harbor cargo ship, under surveillance, amid waves.

end.line: What do you think happened to the missing cash?

description: A quick look at the daring 1950 Brink's vault robbery and its lingering mysteries.

facts.claim: On January 17, 1950, six thieves stole $2.7 million from Brink's.
Investigators found a broken lock and a muddy boot print inside the vault.
One robber was identified as Joseph "Jolly" McGinn, who fled to Canada.
Police discovered the stolen cash hidden in a Boston Harbor cargo ship.

bad: contradicted: One robber, later identified as Joseph 'Jolly' McGinn, fled to Canada after an escape (spravne: Joseph McGinnis)
